column1: Revenue increased by 4.06% from KShs. 44,110 million in 2020 to KShs. 45,901 million in 2021.
This was mainly attributed to revenues from geothermal, hydro generation and diversification
venture at Tulu Moye in Ethiopia. The ongoing geothermal drilling services in Tulu Moye contributed
KShs 1,784 million compared to KShs 440 million in the previous year.
